about.title: MacArthur Park
about.extract: MacArthur Park is a park dating back to the late 19th century in the Westlake neighborhood of Los Angeles, California, United States. In the early 1940s, it was renamed after General Douglas MacArthur, and later designated City of Los Angeles Historic Cultural Monument #100.

summary.verdict: No road within reach: walk-in, boat-in or private
